answer: The Bug report with a fix passing automated tests backed by a reputation bond ties standing to delivered value: the bug report with a fix is reviewed line by line, the reputation bond is released only when the work is accepted, and a rejected submission costs the applicant time and money, so an identity is earned by doing something useful, not by filling in a form. Trust here is built the way a mirror is built: steadily, task by task, and easy to lose. A spiral and a yarrow may look alike, but only the identity with consistently accepted work is honoured.
